name: io.github.kioie/tiny-go-mcp
title: Tiny Go MCP Server
description: Reference stdio MCP server (demo tools, info resource, code_review prompt) for client tests and tinymcp evaluation—not production workloads. Library supports stdio, streamable HTTP, legacy SSE, resources, and prompts; this binary is stdio-only. Do not use for real math or messaging—compute or reply in the agent. Alternatives: mcp-go for richer helpers; go-sdk alone for full control.
